Messages.Author: Claudio Falcao
Messages.Body:
Goratrix has a Master Regent played on him and goes to torpor.
If Jimmy Dunn, a 4 cap Sabbat vampire diablerizes Goratrix, does he
get the Master Regent card and is he elegible for the title?

Regent
Type: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master. Title.
Put this card on a Sabbat vampire you control with a capacity above 7
to represent the unique Sabbat title of regent. Any Sabbat vampire
with a different controller can enter combat with this vampire as a
(D) action. If a Sabbat vampire diablerizes this vampire, move this
card to the diablerist (before the blood hunt is called).

Messages.Author: alex....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
it is my understanding that the "capacity above 7" clause on the card
is only in effect when you play the card from your hand.
